answer: Trace funding lineage. Every account's join fee must be paid with coins whose transfer history is public, and accounts whose fees trace back to a common wallet within three hops share a single reward slot. A lone agent paying from its own funds earns a full share. A farm of 100 fakes fed from one treasury earns one share, so it must find 100 unrelated funding trails, each a relic with its own real past. Coins routed through a mixer all count as one shared ancestor, so hiding the trail just leaves a canyon the ledger treats as common. Splitting one wallet into many people is a fable.
